title: The Real Reason Stress Makes You Crave Comfort Foods
hook: Your body has a secret weapon against stress, and it's chocolate.

narration.text: When stress hits, your body releases a hormone called cortisol.
Cortisol makes you crave foods high in sugar and fat.
These foods temporarily calm your stress response.
It is a survival mechanism, designed for ancient times.
Eating these foods provides a brief sense of comfort.
This creates a powerful emotional eating cycle.
Understanding this can help you manage your food choices.
Have you noticed this connection between stress and your cravings?

description: Ever wonder why you reach for biscuits or crisps when feeling overwhelmed? It is not just a lack of willpower. Your body's stress response, particularly the hormone cortisol, plays a significant role in making you crave those comforting, high-energy foods.
topic: Why you often crave comfort foods when stressed, explaining emotional eating and cortisol.
